name: Taiwan FactCheck Center — Nocturnal bounded workflow pilot outreach
deadline_note: Partner outreach route; no grant deadline or funding award is implied.

packet_requirements.description: Inspect the current TFC contact surface and map name/email/subject/message fields without changing the outreach copy unless a real field limit requires compression.
Final Send remains human-protected. Save/copy the completed message and stop before irreversible transmission.
If TFC responds positively, partner willingness and the first bounded non-sensitive case are separate human/partner gates.

compliance_checks: Do not state or imply TFC endorsement, partnership, funding or adoption before affirmative agreement.
Do not propose private-person surveillance, harassment or punitive profiling as the pilot use case.
Do not claim external workflow improvement until a real measured pilot result exists.
Preserve the negative-result-acceptable framing; this is an evaluation request, not a marketing validation request.
